description: This file defines the abstract class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef, which manages allowed child nodes within an HTML purification process, including definitions, validation, and related configurations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef
classes.description: An abstract class that defines allowed child nodes and validates nodes according to specified rules during HTML purification.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the list of elements that are permitted as children, based on the configuration.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Abstract method for validating child nodes against the definition, determining whether to keep, remove, or replace children.
